blind.description: A wooden post supported on a cruciform timber base with dark metal reinforcement brackets. An arched wrought iron / dark metal arm extends outward from the top of the post, suspending a brass/bronze bell with an attached pull rope and tassel beneath. Suspended underneath the iron arm closer to the post is a small dark metal square lantern housing an unlit candle. All surfaces are clean, solid, and stylised hand-painted game-asset quality.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a square wooden post top with an iron strap collar, an iron curved bracket extending to the right holding a circular brass bell bell-mouth, with a small lantern roof below the arm and a four-legged wooden cross base extending beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 ft 6 in to 5 ft tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 2.5 ft wide across the base and cantilevered bell.

notes: footprint is wider than catalog estimate due to cruciform timber base and cantilevered arm
